mapper.select: SELECT enabled FROM actor_access WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND actor_id=#{actor} FOR SHARE
SELECT tenant_id,plugin_id,enabled,epoch,plugin_version,plugin_digest FROM installation WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND plugin_id=#{plugin} FOR SHARE
SELECT source_task_id FROM task_session_scope_target FORCE INDEX(PRIMARY) WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND caller_task_id=#{caller} ORDER BY ordinal LIMIT 9

SELECT tenant_id,id,owner_actor_id,idempotency_key,request_digest,request_snapshot,goal,capabilities,installation_epoch,policy_version,record_version,state,revision,created_at,updated_at,deadline,ready_at,cancel_requested_at,current_attempt_id,worker_id,fence,lease_until,next_event_seq,max_models,max_tools,models_used,tools_used,token_held,max_tokens,code,summary,model_snapshot,model_digest,evaluation_run_id,cost_held,max_cost_micros,tools_snapshot,tools_digest,report_time,evaluation_snapshot,evaluation_digest,evaluation_phase,evaluation_sample,evaluation_model,material_snapshot,material_digest,material_system_digest,material_file_snapshot,material_file_digest,execution_scope_digest,business_policy_snapshot,business_policy_digest,media_snapshot,media_digest,media_cleanup_state,mcp_snapshot,mcp_digest,question_binding,question_binding_digest,waiting_question_id,question_continuation_step_id,question_cleanup_state,question_retained_digests FROM task WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND owner_actor_id=#{actor} AND idempotency_key=#{key} FOR UPDATE

SELECT tenant_id,id,owner_actor_id,request_digest,capabilities,installation_epoch,record_version,state,revision,created_at,updated_at,cancel_requested_at,deadline,code,summary,next_event_seq,tools_snapshot,tools_digest,mcp_snapshot,mcp_digest FROM task WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{task} FOR UPDATE
SELECT id FROM task WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND evaluation_run_id=#{run} AND evaluation_model=#{model} AND evaluation_sample=#{sample} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE task SET model_snapshot=#{modelSnapshot},model_digest=#{modelDigest},evaluation_run_id=#{run},max_cost_micros=#{cost},tools_snapshot=#{toolsSnapshot},tools_digest=#{toolsDigest},execution_scope_digest=#{scope},report_time=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{task}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO task_directory(tenant_id,task_id,binding_snapshot,binding_digest,namespace_digest,cwd,retain_until) SELECT tenant_id,id,#{binding},#{digest},#{namespace},'/',TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND,604800,created_at) FROM task WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{task}

INSERT INTO task_todo_projection(tenant_id,task_id,binding_snapshot,binding_digest,retain_until) SELECT tenant_id,id,#{binding},#{digest},TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND,604800,created_at) FROM task WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{task}
mapper.update: UPDATE task SET question_binding=#{binding},question_binding_digest=#{digest},question_cleanup_state='RETAINED' WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{task}
UPDATE task SET mcp_snapshot=#{snapshot},mcp_digest=#{digest} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{task}
UPDATE task SET record_version=2,business_policy_snapshot=#{snapshot},business_policy_digest=#{digest},max_tokens=#{tokens} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{task}
UPDATE tenant_budget SET storage_held=storage_held+#{amount} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant}
UPDATE reservation SET actual=amount WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{reservation}

UPDATE task SET evaluation_snapshot=#{snapshot},evaluation_digest=#{digest},evaluation_phase=#{phase},evaluation_sample=#{sample},evaluation_model=#{model},max_models=LEAST(max_models,#{maxModels}),max_tokens=#{tokens},max_cost_micros=LEAST(max_cost_micros,#{cost}) WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{task}
UPDATE task SET material_snapshot=#{snapshot},material_digest=#{digest},material_system_digest=#{systemDigest} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{task}
UPDATE task SET max_cost_micros=#{cost} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{task}
UPDATE tenant_budget SET queued=queued+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant}
